title: Tinge
description: Adds color grading to vanilla minecraft! (polytone)
body:
![picture frame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c771e1c3eb38b40fbdf5cc267833d9a8c42fc41_0.webp)
### Tinge adds color grading to vanilla minecraft via core shaders and polytone!
_(polytone is required for this to work so technically not vanilla)_

### compatible with sodium!

to change color grading settings (or presets) unzip the folder and get to assets/tinge/shaders/post and edit "colorgrade.fsh" (customize to your own liking or pick a preset brah)

_highly recommend using [cbbg](https://modrinth.com/mod/cbbg?version=1.21.11) since it helps get rid of banding_
